readings: Consider only transactions whose amount (`trans.amount`) is strictly greater than 2400. For each account (`trans.account_id`), compute (1) its average signed amount over those transactions, counting 'PRIJEM' as +amount and 'VYDAJ' as −amount and leaving out other or missing types, and (2) its average balance after transaction (`trans.balance`) over all of its transactions above 2400, whatever their type. Return one row with the average across accounts of figure 1 and then of figure 2, unrounded. Accounts with no signed amount are skipped for figure 1.

Consider only transactions whose amount (`trans.amount`) is at least 2400, so 2400 is included. For each account (`trans.account_id`), compute (1) its average signed amount over those transactions, counting 'PRIJEM' as +amount and 'VYDAJ' as −amount and leaving out other or missing types, and (2) its average balance after transaction (`trans.balance`) over all of its transactions of 2400 or more, whatever their type. Return one row with the average across accounts of figure 1 and then of figure 2, unrounded. Accounts with no signed amount are skipped for figure 1.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance
FROM (
    SELECT account_id,
           AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount > 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
);

SELECT AVG(avg_signed), AVG(avg_bal)
FROM (
    SELECT account_id,
           AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_bal
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount >= 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
)
